name: com.zen.core
description: Base for Unity games in one package: Base.dll, DataManager, UI, currency, extensions, vibration, ads (AdMob + AdZative native waterfall, UMP, ATT, AppsFlyer, Taichi, review / update, splash, debug tools), IAP (Unity IAP), Firebase (Analytics, Remote Config, Crashlytics), screens (ScreenUtils) and Base > Hub. Optional SDKs switch their part off when missing.
